briefdescription.para: Write the bytes specified in Buffer to the underlying stream.

detaileddescription.para: On success, updates the offset so that subsequent writes will occur at the next unwritten position.

simplesect.para: a success error code if the data was successfully written, otherwise returns an appropriate error code.

briefdescription.para: Efficiently reads all data from Ref, and writes it to this stream.

detaileddescription.para: This operation will not invoke any copies of the source data, regardless of the source stream's implementation.

briefdescription.para: Writes the object Obj to the underlying stream, as if by using memcpy.

detaileddescription.para: It is up to the caller to ensure that type of Obj can be safely copied in this fashion, as no checks are made to ensure that this is safe.

briefdescription.para: Splits the Writer into two Writers at a given offset.
Provides write only access to a subclass of WritableBinaryStream.

detaileddescription.para: Provides bounds checking and helpers for writing certain common data types such as null-terminated strings, integers in various flavors of endianness, etc. Can be subclassed to provide reading and writing of custom datatypes, although no methods are overridable.
